description: He wears a blue wool knee-length tunic with pale geometric embroidery around the split neckline, cuffs, front opening and hem, over a light linen underlayer. A heavy brown patterned cloak with woven borders is fastened at one shoulder by a round brooch. A brown leather belt has a square decorated buckle and long hanging end. Brown trousers, wrapped lower legs and brown leather boots complete the outfit; his head is bare.
